research.title: NCETM — Cardinality and Counting
research.retrieval: Public HTML cardinality, subitising, numeral meanings and conservation sections read during B06 preparation.
research.adopted: Connect whole quantities with labels, allow subitising/direct answers and recognise rearrangement without addition/removal.
research.rejected: No mandatory tapping/naming or copied progression as a hard prerequisite.
research.limitations: Foreign early-years conceptual comparison, not validated Finnish1–2 efficacy.
research.usageRestrictions: Original prose/diagrams only. Copyright page read: default Crown/OGL, author exceptions; no source figures used.

research.title: University of Cambridge NRICH — Show Me
research.retrieval: Public HTML activity, mathematical journey and variation sections read; linkedPDF not read.
research.adopted: Same quantity represented in varied layouts and labels, including constructing a requested group.
research.rejected: No teen-number or additive-strategy requirement imported.
research.limitations: Source age3–5 comparison; this adaptation and small numeric range are project designs.
research.usageRestrictions: ©University of Cambridge; no source activity text, illustrations or cards copied.

research.title: NSW Department of Education — Connecting number names, numerals and quantities
research.retrieval: Public HTML identifying numerals, representations and collections; staff-only pack/cards/videos not opened.
research.adopted: Distinguish representation matching from oral naming; connect concrete/visual/verbal/symbolic quantities.
research.rejected: No English teen/ty distinction, free oral-production claim or racing requirement.
research.limitations: Public guidance only, not a review of the complete resource or learner efficacy.
research.usageRestrictions: No redistribution licence inferred; no source graphics/text reused.

research.title: OPH — Perusopetuksen opetussuunnitelman perusteet2014, Matematiikka1–2 S2
research.retrieval: Targeted PDFp128/printed129 S2 quantity/word/numeral relationship independently read during prep.
research.adopted: Broad concrete-quantity and representation connection behind inherited S2 reference.
research.rejected: Does not prescribe these exact2 split nodes, controls, numeric examples or process evidence policy.
research.limitations: Frozen2014 basis, no claim to certify all current amendments. Canonical source_basis remains pedagogically_derived.
research.usageRestrictions: ©OPH; paraphrase only, no source figures copied.
